name: Logansport

holders.name: Jacob Pomasl
holders.note: Listed as Mayor by the city. Mayor Chris Martin (elected 2023) resigned effective 2026-03-30; his statement said Deputy Mayor Pomasl assumes the duties until a Cass County Republican caucus fills the seat (raw/logansport-in/martin-resign.html). Whether he was formally caucused/sworn in is not confirmed.

holders.name: Mike Stajduhar
holders.note: Tyler Pearson won the 2023 race (results2023.pdf); the city directory now lists Stajduhar, so a mid-term change happened. How and when is not documented in a saved page.

Ward 1 = Clay City, Noble City, Logansport 1; Ward 2 = Logansport 2, Washington City; Ward 3 = Logansport 3, Logansport 4; Ward 4 = Logansport 5 minus census blocks 18001709515001001 and 18001709515001005; Ward 5 = Logansport 6, Logansport 7 plus those two blocks. These precinct names are the pre-2022 names? The ordinance says Cass County precincts approved Dec 2021 effective 2022-01-02. Pages 2-5 (maps) not OCR-read. No ArcGIS layer found.

notes: The 2023 county results (Wards 1-5, At-Large vote for two) match the council page for all 7 seats. Mayor and Clerk-Treasurer changed mid-term (see holder notes).
